Start a chain of quests leading the Ascalonian [[Refugee]]s to [[Kryta]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Eliminate the [6...0] remaining [[Centaur]] [[patrol]][s] along the main road.
* See [[Ranger Olson]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

===Environmental changes===
* [[Refugee]]s will continue to spawn in [[Deldrimor Bowl]] after completing the quest.
* The centaur groups killed for this quest, specifically those directly on the refugees' path, will no longer spawn.

==Walkthrough==
Exit [[Beacon's Perch]] into [[Deldrimor Bowl]] and follow the quest markers westwards, killing the [[centaur]] groups you encounter along the way. The groups you are required to kill for the quest might not be precisely at the quest markers, but they will be close enough to find simply by following the southern path. You will meet numerous [[refugee]]s along the way who will fight the centaurs with you; they are individually quite weak and likely to die, but there is no requirement to keep them alive, only to kill the centaurs.

After you have killed the six groups indicated by the quest markers, speak to [[Ranger Olson]], who will be nearby at the start of the path leading to [[Griffon's Mouth]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Master Saberlin
:''We've encountered '''Centaur patrols''' on the road ahead, and they're attacking the caravan! I need you to take them out quickly and report to '''Ranger Olson'''.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = You can count on me.
| decline = I don't know if I can handle that.
| ask = Follow the main road and take care of the '''Centaur''' patrols! When the way is clear, report to '''Ranger Olson'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Ranger Olson
:''We're fortunate to have your assistance. [[Aidan]] has gone on ahead into the ice caves to scout the way for you to take the refugees through. [[Master Seeker Nathaniel]] awaits you in Griffon's Mouth with further instructions.''

==Notes==
*The next quest in the line isn't given by Ranger Olson, but by [[Master Seeker Nathaniel]] in [[Griffon's Mouth]].
*The quests [[Hungry Devourer]] and [[The Deserters]] will give you additional allies, with those added by The Deserters being significantly stronger.
{{anomaly|Although this quest chronologically follows [[The Frost Gate]], completion of that mission is not required.}}
